blocks.value: **Comments** explain the details in a program. They are notes a programmer writes to help another person understand the code. **Comments are ignored by the compiler**: they are not executed when the program runs.
**Single-line comments** begin with `//` and can be placed anywhere in the line.
System.out.println("Welcome to Java.");   // prints Welcome to Java.
Write comments that explain **why**, not **what**. `i = i + 1; // add one to i` tells the reader nothing they could not see.
